viewing_check: Check whether veneer lifting is on doors or sides, any woodworm, whether top and base are a married pair (back boards, mismatched timbers), drawer construction (hand cut dovetails, secondary timber: cedar/pine = colonial, oak = English), original or replaced knobs, and measure height/width for freight. Photograph back and drawer sides. Also check the cornice and plinth for restoration.
